name: Timothée Chalamet

He began acting in commercials and TV roles as a teenager, with early parts in Law & Order and Homeland before his breakout film roles in 2017 with Call Me by Your Name and Lady Bird.

His sister Pauline is an actress, and his uncle Rodman Flender is a filmmaker. The family lived in Manhattan Plaza, a subsidized building for performing artists.
parent_family_domain_summary: Mother was a Broadway dancer who trained at LaGuardia HS and Yale; uncle Rodman Flender is a film director; aunt Amy Lippman is a TV producer; sister Pauline is an actress. Deep multi-generational performing arts family.
evidence_summary: Chalamet was immersed in the performing arts from birth: his mother was a Broadway dancer, his uncle a filmmaker, and he grew up in Manhattan Plaza, a subsidized housing complex for artists in Hell's Kitchen. He attended LaGuardia High School of Performing Arts, one of the most selective arts schools in the US, where he trained intensively in acting. His sister Pauline is also an actress, creating a family-domain apprenticeship environment. These combined advantages gave him rare domain proximity and elite ecosystem access that directly catalyzed his early career.
starting_point: Born to a former Broadway dancer turned real estate agent and a French journalist in Manhattan's Hell's Kitchen; grew up in subsidized artists' housing in the heart of NYC's theater district.
current_position: Leading Hollywood actor starring in major films like Dune and A Complete Unknown; SAG Award winner; one of the highest-paid actors of his generation with estimated net worth of ~$25M.
